summary: Contestants take an objective test to demonstrate their knowledge of parliamentary procedure, including Robert’s Rules of Order, motion processing, debate rules, voting methods, and meeting management. The event focuses on accurate application of parliamentary law and ethical meeting practices. Any secondary or postsecondary student may enter.
time_limits: no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
submission_requirements: Reference materials are not allowed. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified
competencies: Understand fundamental parliamentary principles and terminology
Identify the classes of motions and their characteristics, including precedence, purpose, and debate rules
Understand the steps and rules for processing motions according to parliamentary procedure
Identify voting methods, requirements, and procedures
Understand basic meeting structure and management, including the order of business, quorum, minutes, and officer roles
Understand rules of debate and member rights, including limits, decorum, and how members obtain the floor
Identify quorum requirements, minute-taking basics, and the purpose of official meeting records
Understand the democratic principles, fairness standards, and ethical expectations that guide parliamentary procedure
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
